sam (pm): Quick sync — customers keep asking for a minimal migration path from prompt->messages. proposing we ship a ‘compat mode’ that accepts both shapes and signals deprecation later. thoughts?

jordan (eng): Compat mode sounds heavy. do we mean run-time translation (prompt->messages) or accept dual API surface with server-side normalization?

sam (pm): leaning toward server-side normalization: accept legacy prompt field + messages, convert prompt into a single user message internally. cheaper for users.

mei (ml): ok but need to be explicit about system role handling. if prompt contains system instructions we should map them to a system message, otherwise we risk role ambiguity and model behavior regressions.

anita (ux): recommend UX: when client sends both, prefer explicit messages and warn about prompt. add a deprecation warning header in responses so integrations see it. show example in docs.

dan (prod-eng): operational concerns: normalization adds a parsing step. can we do it in the edge proxy to avoid changing runtime? that keeps serving path unchanged.

jordan (eng): doing it at edge is neat. implement converter as lightweight transform, include token accounting delta in telemetry. but we need tests for role precedence rules.

mei (ml): precedence proposal: 1) explicit system message in messages array wins 2) fallback to prompt-level system instructions if present 3) default system from model profile if none. also call out prevented constructs: interleaved system messages + function calls could be weird.

anita (ux): docs snippet idea: ```js
// compatibility example
POST /v1/chat/completions
{ "prompt": "You are a friendly assistant.", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Translate to Spanish"}] }
// server normalizes to messages: [{"role":"system","content":"You are a friendly assistant."}, ...]
```

sam (pm): Launch criteria suggestion: must-have: edge transform implemented, docs + deprecation warning, telemetry for conversions, and 3 customer migrations validated. nice-to-have: migration CLI tool, example SDK helpers.

jordan (eng): timeline: can do edge transform + tests in 2 sprints. telemetry + docs second sprint. CLI helper as follow-on.

mei (ml): add eval gating: run 50k prompts vs normalized messages, measure hallucination/regression rates. block launch if >1% regression on critical prompts.

dan (prod-eng): SLA/latency impact: measure p95 added latency from transform at edge. target <10ms median, <25ms p95. otherwise push normalization to async or require explicit opt-in header.

sam (pm): tradeoffs noted. customer asks: large enterprise wants strict role enforcement (no prompt fallback), small customers want zero-friction. propose feature flag per-tenant: "strict_roles": true/false. default false.

anita (ux): include clear onboarding copy for strict mode — explain behavior differences and migration path.

jordan (eng): implementation sketch: edge accepts both shapes, applies precedence logic, emits header X-Redwood-Compat: converted|native, and sets response warning if prompt used. config flag per-tenant stored in tenant config service.

mei (ml): we also need model selection behavior: if normalized length grows, bucket into longer-context variant or enforce truncation. add a safety policy.

sam (pm): ok next steps: jordan + dan + mei to draft PR for edge transform + tests. anita to draft doc warning + examples. i'll line up 2 customers for migration validation. follow-up in 1 week. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch/compat-edge-transform (#425) — smoke tests scheduled.
